## Description

Tracks 2-dimensional Betti numbers (3D topological voids) in multi-asset correlation point clouds to detect higher-order structural collapse in global asset dependency networks prior to systemic crises.

## Where it may fit

Pre-crash global macro environments, systemic credit crunches, complex inter-market correlation breakdowns.

## Vehicles

Global Macro Hedge Funds, Tail-Risk Funds, Institutional Risk Management Desks.

## Required data

Rolling cross-asset correlation tensors, global macro indicator time series.

## Caveats

Betti-2 topological computation is computationally expensive for high-dimensional point clouds.
